observations: Photo 0: Industrial-style sewing machine head mounted on a table, white/cream body, viewed from an angle, no brand visible due to watermark overlay.
Photo 1: Same sewing machine head, closer view, oval brand badge visible on body but text obscured by watermark.
Photo 2: Sewing machine mounted on a wooden-top table with visible underside motor and belt mechanism, legs show rust and paint wear, brand badge reads 'Emel'.
Photo 3: Close-up side view of machine head showing red oval badge clearly reading 'Emel', some paint chipping on housing, tiny spoked wheel on left side.
not_shown: Completeness of accessories (bobbins, needles, foot pedal)
